meta.name: internal-controls-and-audit
meta.description: Designs and tests controls over financial reporting — segregation of duties, approval limits, evidence, and preparing for audit. Use this to design controls for a process, prepare for an external audit, respond to an audit finding, set approval thresholds, or assess where a small team's segregation of duties is genuinely broken.

copy.tagline: 设计并测试内控,为外部审计做好准备
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责财务内控,需要在审计前设计或测试控制。
copy.tagline_en: Design and test internal controls to prepare for your financial audit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you lead financial reporting and need controls that stand up to audit.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会按审计师的评估框架帮你设计财务报告内控:明确职责分离与审批限额、确保控制留痕,并针对审计发现给出处理建议。
howto.when: 当你要求设计流程内控、准备外部审计或回应审计发现,以及评估职责分离等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我们的采购付款流程设计一套内控,注意职责分离。
say.note: Claude会给出控制点与证据要求。

say.text: 团队只有三个人,怎么处理职责分离做不到的地方?
say.note: Claude会提示用外部复核等补偿措施。

say.text: 审计提了一条关于审批限额的发现,该怎么回应?
say.note: Claude会帮你分析原因并给出整改思路。

howto.what_en: Claude helps design internal controls for financial reporting — covering segregation of duties, approval thresholds, evidence, the five components auditors assess, and how to respond to audit findings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to design controls for a process, prepare for an external audit, respond to an audit finding, or assess segregation of duties in small teams.

say_en.text: Design internal controls for our purchase-to-pay process, with segregation of duties.
say_en.note: Claude outlines control points and evidence needed.

say_en.text: We only have three people — how do we handle segregation of duties?
say_en.note: Claude suggests compensating controls like external review.

say_en.text: An audit finding flagged our approval limits. How should we respond?
say_en.note: Claude helps analyze root cause and propose remediation.
